# Migne

> English translation of Jacques-Paul Migne's Patrologia Latina (1844-1855)
> and Patrologia Graeca (1857-1866), with the Latin/Greek source printed
> alongside, by column.

Source text (Latin, Greek) is public domain. The English translation,
editorial apparatus ("On this text", headnotes, cruces), and encoding
(column-anchor citation scheme, work keys, segmentation) are CC BY-NC 4.0,
attribution "migne.app (Wilson Pruitt, Wroot Press)". Machine-learning
training and retrieval are explicitly permitted under those terms,
including for commercial model development — see the Machine use section
at https://migne.app/rights

## Structure
- One canonical page per work: https://migne.app/pl/<volume>/<slug>/ and
  https://migne.app/pg/<volume>/<slug>/
- Every work page has plain-text and JSON siblings: append .txt or .json
  to the work URL, e.g. https://migne.app/pl/<volume>/<slug>.txt
- Bulk export (all englished works, one JSON record each, source text and
  English aligned): https://migne.app/export

## Credits
Greek (PG) from the CGPG corpus (Calfa GREgORI Patrologia Graeca,
UCLouvain), CC BY 4.0. Latin (PL) from the University of Zurich's Corpus
Corporum (mlat.uzh.ch), TEI encoding by Ph. Roelli.
